about: Request bodies of the app's Anthropic adapter (packages/providers/src/anthropic-messages.ts). `sent` is the adapter's own output, byte for byte, for the packets in tests/unit/preview-anthropic-gate.test.ts (that test rebuilds every one); `refused` are bodies the adapter never sends. The gate's AnthropicProfile.body_valid and the app's guarded fetch must accept every `sent` body and refuse every `refused` one.

sent.name: system and one user turn
sent.body: {"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","max_tokens":8192,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Is the synthetic claim supported?"}],"system":"You are the synthetic judge.","output_config":{"effort":"high"}}

sent.name: two system messages joined, a full exchange
consecutive user turns joined, no system
non-ASCII text and escapes
sent.body: {"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","max_tokens":1024,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Întrebare: 日本語? emoji 🙂 and   separator"}],"system":"Răspunde în română. \"Citat\" \\ backslash\nnew line\ttab","output_config":{"effort":"high"}}

sent.name: repair: user, assistant, user, assistant joined, user

refused.name: a final assistant turn (the adapter refuses it as a prefill)
two user turns in a row (the adapter joins them)
an empty system text (the adapter leaves system out)
no effort at the default level (the preview always sends high)
